create_task.name: create_task
create_task.description: Creates a task instance in Invoice Ninja for billing purposes.

number.description: A unique task or ticket number that has not been used before in Invoice Ninja

description.description: Description of task to be billed

rate.description: Custom hourly rate (optional) otherwise default used

aiMetadata.description: Creates a billable task in Invoice Ninja, identified by a task/ticket number that must be unique (not previously used). Optionally associates the task with a client and project and applies a custom hourly rate. Not idempotent — each call creates a new task.

exists_task.name: exists_task
exists_task.description: Verify if a Task Already Exists

number.description: A task or ticket number to check

aiMetadata.description: Checks whether a task with the given task/ticket number already exists in Invoice Ninja, returning a truthy/falsy result. Use to guard against duplicate task creation before calling Create Task. Read-only and idempotent.

getclient_task.name: getclient_task
getclient_task.description: Gets the client details if they exist by e-mail.

email.description: A valid e-mail address to get client details for

aiMetadata.description: Looks up a client in Invoice Ninja by email address and returns a trimmed set of their details (id, name, balances, address, contacts). Use to resolve a client id or fetch client info from an email; returns a falsy result when no matching client is found. Read-only and idempotent.

invoiceStatus.description: Select the invoice status for filtering.

clientID.description: Filter by Client ID, default is all clients.

numberOfResults.description: Maximum number of results to return. 9999 is default.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves invoices from Invoice Ninja filtered by status (unpaid, paid, overdue, or all) and optionally by client id, capped by a max-results limit. Use to list or report on invoices; omitting the client id returns invoices across all clients. Read-only and idempotent.

clientID.description: Filter by Client ID, default is all clients.

numberOfResults.description: Maximum number of results to return. 9999 is default.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches report data from Invoice Ninja for the selected report type (currently invoices) over a fixed last-7-days range, capped by a max-results limit. Use to pull aggregated invoice report data. Read-only and idempotent.

create_invoice.name: create_invoice
create_invoice.description: Creates an invoice in Invoice Ninja for billing purposes.

discount.description: Enter a number for the whole invoice discount

discount_type.description: Select either amount or percentage for invoice discount. Applies to line items and invoice.

public_notes.description: Text that may be visible in the client portal (optional)

send_email.displayName: Send invoice to the client by InvoiceNinja e-mail?
send_email.description: Should we send the invoice to the client on creation?

mark_sent.description: Makes the invoice active otherwise remains pending.

aiMetadata.description: Creates an invoice for a client in Invoice Ninja from a JSON array of line items (each referencing an existing product_key, whose price and tax are looked up), with optional discount, notes, and due date. Can optionally email the invoice to the client and/or mark it as sent on creation. Requires a valid client id and at least one line item with a known product key. Not idempotent — each call creates a new invoice.

create_client.name: create_client
create_client.description: Creates a new client in InvoiceNinja.

client_first_name.description: The contact first name for this client (optional)

client_last_name.description: The contact last name for this client (optional)

client_phone.description: The contact number for this client (optional)

client_email.description: The contact email for this client (compulsory)

client_send_email.description: Should we send invoices to the client by e-mail?

client_business_name.description: Name of this business or natural person (compulsory)

client_tax_no.description: Leave blank if not a business (optional)

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new client record in Invoice Ninja with a primary contact, requiring business name, contact email, address line 1, and city; other contact and address fields are optional. Not idempotent — each call creates a new client even if one with the same details already exists.

create_recurring_invoice.name: create_recurring_invoice
create_recurring_invoice.description: Creates a recurring invoice in Invoice Ninja for billing purposes.

discount.description: Enter a number for the whole invoice discount

discount_type.description: Select either amount or percentage for invoice discount. Applies to line items and invoice.

public_notes.description: Text that may be visible in the client portal (optional)

nocycles.description: Enter a number. How many times should this bill be generated

auto_frequency.description: Enter a number. 1-12 - corresponds to dropdown above [Daily being 1, Weekly 2 etc..]!

aiMetadata.description: Creates a recurring invoice for a client in Invoice Ninja from a JSON array of line items (each referencing an existing product_key), set to bill on a chosen frequency for a given number of cycles starting from a next-send date. The frequency can be picked from the preset list or overridden with a numeric frequency id. Requires a valid client id, at least one line item with a known product key, and a next-send date. Not idempotent — each call creates a new recurring invoice.

action_recurring_invoice.name: action_recurring_invoice
action_recurring_invoice.description: Actions include: start, stop, send_now, restore, archive, delete.

recurring_id.description: Recurring Invoice ID from Invoice Ninja

aiMetadata.description: Performs a lifecycle action on an existing recurring invoice in Invoice Ninja, identified by its id. The action prop selects which operation to apply: start, stop, send_now, restore, archive, or delete. Requires a valid recurring invoice id. Treat as not idempotent — actions such as send_now and delete have per-call side effects.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
